crossRefs.note: “Why does this man speak blasphemies like that? Who can forgive sins but God alone?”
The scribes and the Pharisees, when they saw that he was eating with the sinners and tax collectors, said to his…
Why do you see the speck that is in your brother’s eye, but don’t consider the beam that is in your own eye?
“Why do your disciples disobey the tradition of the elders? For they don’t wash their hands when they eat bread.”
He answered them, “Why do you also disobey the commandment of God because of your tradition?
“Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! For you tithe mint, dill, and cumin, and have left undone the weightier…
You blind guides, who strain out a gnat, and swallow a camel!
For consider him who has endured such contradiction of sinners against himself, that you don’t grow weary, fainting in…
but the seventh day is a Sabbath to Yahweh your God. You shall not do any work in it, you, nor your son, nor your…
Six days shall work be done, but on the seventh day is a Sabbath of solemn rest, holy to Yahweh. Whoever does any work…
‘Six days shall work be done, but on the seventh day there shall be a holy day for you, a Sabbath of solemn rest to…
You shall kindle no fire throughout your habitations on the Sabbath day.’ ”
While the children of Israel were in the wilderness, they found a man gathering sticks on the Sabbath day.
In those days I saw some men treading wine presses on the Sabbath in Judah, bringing in sheaves, and loading donkeys…
Blessed is the man who does this, and the son of man who holds it fast; who keeps the Sabbath without profaning it and…
For Yahweh says, “To the eunuchs who keep my Sabbaths, choose the things that please me, and hold fast to my covenant,
Also the foreigners who join themselves to Yahweh to serve him, and to love Yahweh’s name, to be his servants, everyone…
“If you turn away your foot from the Sabbath, from doing your pleasure on my holy day; and call the Sabbath a delight…
Tell them, ‘Hear Yahweh’s word, you kings of Judah, all Judah, and all the inhabitants of Jerusalem, that enter in by…

parallels.note: But the Pharisees, when they saw it, said to him, “Behold, your disciples do what is not lawful to do on the Sabbath.”
But some of the Pharisees said to them, “Why do you do that which is not lawful to do on the Sabbath day?”

translations.web: The Pharisees said to him, “Behold, why do they do that which is not lawful on the Sabbath day?”
translations.bsb: So the Pharisees said to Him, “Look, why are they doing what is unlawful on the Sabbath?”
translations.kjv: And the Pharisees said unto him, Behold, why do they on the sabbath day that which is not lawful?
translations.asv: And the Pharisees said unto him, Behold, why do they on the sabbath day that which is not lawful?
